name: us030-settings-from-files
description: 030 §1/§2/§3: both SPEC_KIT_JIRA_BASE_URL and JIRA_EMAIL are blanked (unset to the ports). The chokepoint seeds both from config.yml's base_url (the @MOCK_BASE_URL@ sentinel) and personal.yml's email — exit 0, discovery reaches the mock successfully. `config` rather than `reconcile`: reconcile's run-state document records a content HASH of config.yml as an input, and that hash itself diverges across ports once the sentinel resolves to two different literal strings — a divergence no post-hoc normalization can undo. `config` writes no such hash.
